C0616.title: Multiple Banks Prohibit Credit Card Cash-Out for Gold Speculation
C0616.summary: In May 2025, Industrial Bank, Bank of Communications, Bank of Jiangsu, Guangfa Bank and other banks issued announcements explicitly banning credit card funds from flowing into investment areas such as gold and stocks. Some investors attempted to arbitrage by cashing out credit cards or diverting consumer loan funds to trade gold, and banks will implement control measures against such violations.
